purpose.en: Build the glutes and strengthen hip extension.

text.zh: 膝盖保持约90度，脚底向天花板推
text.en: Keep your knee at about 90 degrees and push your sole toward the ceiling

text.zh: 双手和支撑膝稳住，躯干不动
text.en: Keep your hands and supporting knee steady and your trunk still.
Keep your lower back from sagging and lower slowly.

commonErrors.en: Sagging the lower back to lift higher.

cautions.zh: 腰部不适时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Reduce the range if your lower back feels uncomfortable, and stop if it still hurts.

cautions.zh: 先做手腕热身；手腕刺痛或发麻就停止
cautions.en: Warm up your wrists first, and stop if they feel sharp pain or numbness.
